seo.title: Atlas Film Studios Ouarzazate | Movie Sets & Desert Cinema | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Tour Atlas Film Studios in Ouarzazate: open-air sets used in international productions — the Hollywood of Morocco.
seo.keywords: Atlas Studios Ouarzazate, Ouarzazate film studios, Hollywood Morocco

name: Atlas Film Studios
hero_subtitle: Décors de cinéma en plein air au bord du désert — temples, façades de kasbah et mythologie du cinéma marocain.

overview.title: Where the desert becomes a film set
overview.p1: Atlas Studios is one of the largest film studios in the world by area. You walk among sets built for epics — mud-brick villages, Egyptian motifs, fortified walls — against real desert light.
overview.p2: Works well as a half-day with Kasbah Taourirt or before Aït Benhaddou. Bring sun protection; shade is limited.

moods.title: Atlas Studios through the day
moods.subtitle: Open ground and little shade — timing is about heat.

1.title: Best light and cooler air
1.desc: Morning is more comfortable for walking between outdoor sets.

2.title: Harsh sun
2.desc: Midday is intense; hat, water and shorter outdoor time help.

3.title: Softer shadows
3.desc: Late afternoon works if energy remains after other stops.

food.title: Eat near the studios
food.p1: On-site options are limited. Most visitors eat in Ouarzazate before or after.
food.p2: The studios are the attraction; dining stays in town.
food.li2: Snack stalls may operate near the entrance.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Taxi from the centre; agree price and wait time if combining stops.

2.title: Sun
2.desc: Almost no shade on the sets — SPF, hat and water essential.

3.title: Expectations
3.desc: You see façades and open sets, not active shoots every day.

q1.question: Do I need a guided tour?
q1.answer: Guided visits are common and helpful; ask at the entrance.

q2.question: How long should I allow?
q2.answer: About one and a half to two and a half hours.

q3.question: Interesting without film knowledge?
q3.answer: Yes — the scale of the sets is the draw.

q4.question: Same day as Aït Benhaddou?
q4.answer: Yes — a frequent pairing with an early start.

q5.question: Photos allowed?
q5.answer: Usually yes outdoors; follow staff rules.
